mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (i.e., negative change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC between the 3-month FEDFUNDS change and 20d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE above 5.0%) indicates a weak labor market, which may prompt central bank easing and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE (above 5.0%) and 20d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is stable, it signals that the central bank is behind the curve, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected future rate hikes.
regime_hint: inflationary environment with delayed policy response
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is rising and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown in the housing sector, which is a key component of aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals a slowdown in the manufacturing sector, which is a key component of real economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC between INDPRO (below 100) and 20d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annualized) signals the Federal Reserve will tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL (above 3.0%) and 60d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines and INDPRO contracts, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in job growth (PAYEMS monthly growth below 0.5%) signals a weakening labor market, which may lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC between PAYEMS growth (below 0.5%) and 5d returns is below 0.03.
